cohort: The study included pregnant women diagnosed with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy attending the department of obstetrics and gynaecology at Chittaranjan Seva Sadan College of Obstetrics and Gynecology and Child Health.
finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy is associated with elevated risks of preterm delivery, increased cesarean section rates, and adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: In 59.0% of the cases, the mode of delivery was Caesarean section, which was significantly higher than vaginal delivery (41.0%).
